title: Annotatio IV §.XIX open: English Waldenses XIV under Wycliffites — succeeded by Bohemian Hussites XV
pass_a_gloss: §. XIX. The Waldenses in England, celebrated under the Wycliffites’ name in the XIVth Age, are succeeded in the XVth AGE by the BOHEMIAN WALDENSES, surnamed HUSSITES from John Hus, Wycliffe’s Disciple, and through Wycliffe’s Writings brought from England into Bohemia by Jerome of Prague, excellently taught the true sentence against the Papacy.
pass_b_english: §.XIX: the Waldenses celebrated in England under the Wycliffites’ name in Age XIV are succeeded in Age XV by the BOHEMIAN WALDENSES.
Surnamed HUSSITES from John Hus — Wycliffe’s disciple — taught the true anti-papal sentence through Wycliffe’s writings brought from England by Jerome of Prague.
source_text: §. XIX. Waldenses in Anglia, sub Wiclephitarum nomine, Seculo XIV. celebres, excipiunt SECULO XV. WALDENSES BOHEMI, HUSSITÆ cognominati à Johanne Husso, Wiclephi Discipulo, perque Scripta Wiclephi, ab Hieronymo Pragensi, ex Anglia in Bohemiam, delata, veram sententiam adversus Papatum egregiè edocto.
notes: §.XIX open: England XIV → Bohemia XV Hussites.
